local_build.environment: current local Node and Vite toolchain

browser_runtime.environment: real browser at desktop reference viewport

rationale.interaction: Navigation may include lazy module evaluation; repeated local list interactions should remain below perceptible response delay.
rationale.generation: Ten fresh-process checks exercise exact source reads, hashing, parsing, validation, and deterministic output comparison.
rationale.bundle: The Foundation remains a lazy surface. Budgets limit integration-specific transfer without charging shared React or Workspace runtime bytes to this feature.

failure_policy: Measured failures fail the benchmark command. Missing environment-dependent evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE and remains visible.
claim_ceiling: Local candidate benchmarks only. Passing does not establish browser portability, product approval, conformance, release readiness, deployment readiness, or product value.
